name: Bianchi
verdict: Italian bicycle brand (F.I.V. Edoardo Bianchi SpA) of Cycleurope AB, part of Salvatore Grimaldi's Swedish holding Grimaldi Industri AB. Nothing found.
note: Bahrain Victorious bike supplier from 2026; its logo is on the chest and sleeves of the 2026 jersey. Rating note: Grimaldi Industri's owner is sourced to BikeBiz (2000); no state or state fund is sourced in the chain.
